question: ‘Pinjar’ is a novel by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amrita Pritam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amrita Pritam** is the author of the novel '**Pinjar**'.
 
• Amrita Pritam was a prominent Indian writer and poet, known for her work in **Punjabi and Hindi literature**.
 
• 'Pinjar' is a powerful novel that explores the **trauma and struggles of women during the partition of India **in 1947.
 
• The novel was later adapted into a critically acclaimed film of the same name in 2003.
 
• Amrita Pritam's work often delves into themes of love, loss, and social issues, making her one of the most important literary figures in Indian history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amrita Pritam** was born on 31st August 1919 and passed away on 31st October 2005.
 
• She was the first prominent woman **Punjabi poet, novelist, and essayist**.
 
• Her works have been translated into several languages and she received numerous awards, including the Sahitya Akademi Award, the Padma Shri, and the Padma Vibhushan.
 
• 'Pinjar' remains one of her most celebrated works, highlighting the plight and resilience of women during one of the most turbulent times in Indian history.
 
• Amrita Pritam's legacy continues to inspire new generations of writers and readers around the world.
